decision.reason: All six evidence excerpts, including the two EC2NodeClass CRD files [ev-8998581760b8] and [ev-451bd6a12e72], contain only "---". So no upstream text shows the storage-version change, whether v1beta1 is still served in this release, or that anything fails or must be migrated at this upgrade. The only claim comes from the computed diff's own summary. That summary says objects stay stored as v1beta1 and need migrating "before a later release removes v1beta1", which describes a future break (deprecation-like), not a mandatory step for this upgrade. To settle the consequence kind, we need the CRD contents (served/storage flags for v1beta1 and v1) or upgrade-guide text saying whether migration is mandatory for this release.
